blocks.eyebrow: Starter slot - not a lesson yet
blocks.title: One PLC concept goes here
blocks.body: This page is a labeled placeholder. It becomes real when one automation or PLC concept is taught here for real.

blocks.title: Nothing here is a claim
blocks.body: This slot exists to test collections and page patterns. The lesson that lands here must separate demonstrated work, understood concepts, and material still being learned.

blocks.heading: What the real page will need
items: One concept only - the narrowest useful slice.
A thin exercise with an observable result.
An explanation in the contributor's own words.
An honest label: done, understood, or still learning.

blocks.heading: What belongs in this slot
blocks.prompt: Which page would honor the teaching standard here?
options: A whole PLC course compressed into one long page
One narrow concept with a small working check and an honest explanation
A polished summary of a manual, with nothing actually tried
blocks.explanation: One concept, a thin exercise, an observable result, and an explanation in the contributor's own words. Anything bigger belongs in several pages.

blocks.heading: Teach one thing, prove it works
blocks.body: The exercise and the explanation are the page. The rest is decoration.
